01b57339a0: Before anything is drawn, TubeBook turns your book into nameable physical scenes — one for the cover, one per chapter. 57b04f98cc: This is the setting that decides whether you can stand behind your own book, and it is easy to confuse with fidelity. They answer different questions:
70cd14d526: Fidelity governs expression — the structure, the ordering, the wording, which examples appear.
ae95aaa9cf: Grounding governs substance — which facts, figures, names and claims may appear at all.
21dda32a10: TubeBook never searches the web while writing your book. There is no retrieval step, no live lookup, nothing added from the internet once generation starts. But that is not the same promise as "only your sources": a large AI model carries an enormous amount of subject knowledge, and left unconstrained it will happily supply a statistic, a date or a piece of background you never provided. So you choose:
f9be064274: My sources only (default) — every fact, figure, name, quotation and example must come from the material you supplied. If the model knows something relevant that your sources do not contain, it is left out. Depth comes from working your material harder, not from importing new material.
71221e47c9: Sources + AI knowledge — your sources stay the backbone, and the AI may add well-established background where it genuinely helps. Books built this way are badged on your dashboard so you can spot them later.
2121a85334: Neither setting may invent evidence. On both, the model is forbidden from inventing statistics, studies, citations or quotations, and from attributing anything to a named person or organisation that your sources do not. "Sources + AI knowledge" means add background, never add evidence.
9b7c039d1a: 💡 Why My sources only is the default: it is the only setting you can truly vouch for. Everything in the book traces back to something you chose. If you switch to the other one, fact-check anything you cannot trace to a source before you publish.
1eb0f76eb0: Combine My sources only with High Fidelity and you have a genuine "restructure my own manuscript" mode — your material is the only thing allowed in.
4088cb0474: One nuance worth stating, because the two settings look like they collide: on Low Fidelity with My sources only, the AI writes original prose and original illustrations of your points, but it may not invent facts to fill them. An invented number is invented whether or not it replaced a real one.

79768a1e20: It shifts register, rhythm and vocabulary, and it is the single biggest lever on how a generated book reads. It will not make the writing indistinguishable from yours, and we would rather say so than let you find out. A few pages works far better than a few paragraphs: one paragraph is an accident, a few pages is a style.

b2dd003a8d: Your cover artwork and every chapter illustration are reused — copied into the new edition, so it keeps working even if you later delete the original. e937d32a5e: Translated — every chapter, the title, the subtitle and the chapter list, as a book for readers in that language rather than word for word. Idioms become that language's idioms; proper nouns, brand names, numbers and statistics stay exactly as they are.

fa4a6d54b2: Redrawn — the cover lettering, in the new language, over the same artwork.
53d5abd7b4: 💡 Only these seven languages are offered, and the reason is worth knowing: the copyright page, the contents and the section headings are properly localised for exactly these. e80cfa7746: You get a file per part, with a player on each so you can skip to the one you want to check. Nothing is re-narrated and no credits are spent — you already paid for those parts.
